about_the_game:
You are the Lightbearer, and light is your only weapon. The shadows will reach for your mind, the lighthouse will weaken, and your sanity will be tested. Use the power of light to hold back the darkness, protect the lighthouse, and survive.

Explore the haunted halls of the lighthouse, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets hidden in the gloom. Unlock new spells, upgrade your base, and grow stronger with every run—because when you fall, the nightmare begins again in a new, procedurally generated layout.

Light in Light Bearer is not just atmosphere—it is the heart of the game. With your magic light tool, you can:

  • Store and transfer light between lanterns, torches, and other sources.

  • Cast light-based spells to defend yourself or reveal hidden truths.

  • Expose the unseen, uncovering paths and dangers invisible to the eye.

Every decision matters: will you spend your last light to keep your sanity… or risk the dark for one more chance at survival?
